owner_decision.statement: The canonical STYNX line remains 1.x and the next unified version is exactly 1.3.1 for the complete 44-package release unit: the patch that corrects the 1.3.0 CHANGELOG sibling references and carries the fixed-group version rule, the k6 baseline comparison revision, and the vendored image-size fork on TypeScript 6. This supersedes the earlier 2026-09-12 decision naming 1.3.0, which was published the same day and remains the immutable 1.3.0 release; the superseded decision is preserved in git history.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
anomalies.closure_condition: Unified 1.3.1 is verified for all 44 publishable packages, latest resolves to 1.3.1, and angular-profile 2.0.0 remains immutable non-canonical history. (The 1.2.0 and 1.3.0 closures were met on 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-12; the exception is carried forward because 2.0.0 still sits above the canonical line.)
